description: Per-pixel SPAD timing offset (ps) relative to the sensor-wide median, from cross-correlation of each pixel's IRF with the re-aligned pooled IRF (sub-bin; flim_core.pixel_offset.estimate_offsets_from_irf). Orientation as returned by flim_core.io.load_flim_data. NaN = fewer than 30 IRF photons.
notes: 40x objective, foil, nd3, low 100%, 30 s, 2026-11-17. Checked against 3 other 40 MHz/3560 foil IRFs (nd3/nd4, focus/no focus): r = 0.99-1.00, 9-24 ps rms apart.
